I am growing beans on this quarter-hectare plot, and since beans can fix their own nitrogen from the air, I do not see the need to waste my limited fertilizer coupons here when my maize plots need them more. I will spread some manure that my cattle have produced over this plot before planting, as I have always done, and I will use seed saved from last season's harvest because it has done well for me. We will manage the work within the family since the plot is not large, and I do not have money to buy chemicals or hire extra hands when the rains are enough for beans.
